evidenceBoundary.direct: The actual source loads a tag-1 disk context for the declared interface and supplies its declared method slot to this complete compiled adapter.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Class/table offsets and pointer-pair contents are observed representation; live class initialization and interface implementation identity are not inferred from disk names.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: With a correctly resolved interface class and compatible readable tables, the matching-entry path derives an InvokeData pair from a word counter, wrapped DWORD slot sum and signed extension, then passes the original receiver and MethodInfo to the function pointer. It copies twenty-four bits-preserving result bytes from the returned reference. If that selected function is the current named default interface implementation, its checked body returns twenty-four zero bytes.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: The live interface cell, actual method pointer/implementation, lookup result, preparation/lookup/callee effects, returned values and invocation.
